## Plan

1. `hh-ledger::retention` — declared `RetentionPolicy` {policy_ref,
   blob_residency_ms, bundle_retention_ms, compress_cold}; hot/warm/cold
   tier classes; HHZ1 deterministic codec for cold-tier compression at
   rest (content addressing preserved: the file stays named by the
   plaintext digest; `get_blob` decompresses then verifies).
2. `lifecycle.ledger.tier_transition` audit row + tier fold rebuilt at
   `load_all`; `Store::evaluate_retention` scheduler — durable
   transition rows commit before any byte mutation; monotone
   none→hot→warm→cold; bound/pinned content held warm; idempotent
   repair of a cold row over raw bytes.
3. `gc` bound-set seam (`gc_bounded`) — bundle/leaderboard citation pins
   refuse `Pinned` (CF-347); `lifecycle.ledger.tier_transition` rows are
   subjects, not content references — excluded from `pin_reason`.
4. `subscribe` replay emits the spec'd `Rewind` frame for each replayed
   `lifecycle.head.moved` row; typed `n/a` (`Missing{gc|redacted}` /
   `BlobCorrupt`) never fabricates.
5. Escalation emitters the audit obligations name: `Account::exhaust` →
   `lifecycle.escalation.raised{kind: budget_hard}`; driver `finish` →
   `lifecycle.escalation.raised{kind: effect_unknown}` per effect in
   `unknown` phase at finish.
6. Tests (`tests/r2_2_retention.rs`), ADR-0333, DEFERRALS flips, BL-11,
   BUILD_INDEX 105, LEDGER → R2.3.
